results.name: Preliminary_Plat_Parcels
results.title: Preliminary Plat Parcels
results.description:
This dataset originates from a managed GIS layer of parcel lines that currently housed in Boone County's ArcSDE maintenance database. This parcel dataset depicts features that are currently going through the Boone County Planning Commission's (BCPC) subdivision review process. Platted subdivisions in Boone County must get a series of approvals for each stage of developoment. These stages are: Preliminary Plat, Improvement/Grading Plan, and Final Plat. Subdivision developers that fall under the BCPC's purview are required to submit their digitally-created files to the BCPC for each stage of development. The BCPC uses these digital files to create the parcel lines for this dataset. Importantly - the parcels within this dataset are subject to change and not considered final until the development receives its approval for the Final Plat stage. Furthermore, these parcels must be filed with, and recorded by the County Clerk before being considered a legal land division. The BCPC converts these preliminary plat lines into parcel polygons at that time.

The BCPC's data technicians who are charged with maintaining this dataset are not licensed surveyors. The BCPC has a great deal of respect for the surveying community and the vital role that they play in creating accurate land descriptions. The BCPC wants to therefore stress that the features depicted by this dataset is our best effort to reflect accurate parcel boundaries; However, this dataset must not be construed as survey-quality representations of parcel boundaries. Please consult a licensed surveyor if precise accuracy is of paramount importance to your specific use case.
results.snippet: Line representations of parcels submitted to the Boone County Planning Commission during a development's preliminary plat review
results.accessInformation: Boone County Planning Commission, GIS Services Division

results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.
results.licenseInfo: CREDIT - It is requested, but not required, that the Indiana GIS Data Harvest Program be cited in any products generated from this data set. If citing, the following source citation language should be included: [Parcel Boundaries of Indiana 2021: Parcel Boundaries Maintained by County Agencies in Indiana, (Indiana Geographic Information Office, File Geodatabase, Polygon Feature Class), 20220201].
results.source: Megan R.L. Compton, Indiana Office of Technology, Indiana Geographic Information Officer

results.name: Vacated_Roads
results.title: Vacated Roads
results.description:
This dataset originates from a managed GIS layer of parcel areas currently housed in Boone County's GIS maintenance database. Boone County utilizes geodatabase topology in its GIS maintenance databases to ensure geometric integrity among the various layers housed therein. One significant topology rule enforced on its Parcel dataset is that gaps between its area features must not exist. Although not legally recorded parcels per se, these right-of-way areas are managed within Boone County's Parcel layer in order to enforce the 'no gaps' topology rule. Upon conversion from the maintenance environment to the publishing environment, these right-of-way areas are subtracted from the published parcel layers.

The BCPC's data technicians who are charged with maintaining this dataset are not licensed surveyors. The BCPC has a great deal of respect for the surveying community and the vital role that they play in creating accurate land descriptions. The BCPC wants to therefore stress that the features depicted by this dataset is our best effort to reflect accurate road right-of-ways; However, this dataset must not be construed as survey-quality representations of parcel boundaries. Please consult a licensed surveyor if precise accuracy is of paramount importance to your specific use case.
results.snippet: Area representations of vacated roadways
results.accessInformation: Boone County Planning Commission, GIS Services Division

results.name: Plats
results.title: Plats
results.description:
This dataset is derived from a managed layer of GIS parcel areas currently housed in Boone County's GIS maintenance database. The key process used in deriving the area features within this dataset involves merging legally recorded discreet parcels on file with the County Clerk that have been assigned the same plat identification designation.

The BCPC's data technicians who are charged with maintaining the parcel layer in the GIS maintenance database that this dataset is derived from are not licensed surveyors. The BCPC has a great deal of respect for the surveying community and the vital role that they play in creating accurate land descriptions. The BCPC wants to therefore stress that the features depicted by this dataset is our best effort to reflect accurate plat and highway plan boundaries; However, this dataset must not be construed as survey-quality representations of plat boundaries. Please consult a licensed surveyor if precise accuracy is of paramount importance to your specific use case.
results.snippet: Area representations of plats
results.accessInformation: Boone County Planning Commission, GIS Services Division
